express: express: the default export, called to build an app
status: express: response method setting the status code
json: express: response method sending a JSON body
send: express: response method sending a body
sendStatus: express: response method sending a bare status
end: express: response method ending the response, with or without a body
redirect: express: response method sending a redirect
set: express: response method setting a header, returns the response
type: express: response method setting Content-Type, returns the response
location: express: response method setting the Location header, returns the response
cookie: express: response method setting a cookie, returns the response
clearCookie: express: response method clearing a cookie, returns the response
append: express: response method appending a header value, returns the response
vary: express: response method adding to the Vary header, returns the response
links: express: response method setting the Link header, returns the response
attachment: express: response method setting Content-Disposition, returns the response
use: express: router method mounting a sub-router under a prefix, and registering middleware and error handlers
